int[][] matrix := [[125, 340, 78, 912, 456], [603, 27, 819, 150, 384], [0, 765, 231, 498, 62], [947, 113, 586, 39, 720]]
columns := array(5, fill = 0)
for row := matrix[]
    columns = columns + row
    for value := row[]
        print("{value:6.}")
    row_sum := row.sum()
    println("{row_sum:6.}")
for column_sum := columns[]
    print("{column_sum:6.}")
println("{columns.sum():6.}")
